items.title: Artin-Mazur-Milne duality for bounded complexes of finite flat commutative group schemes over a curve
items.author: Cyril Demarche; David Harari
items.work: Duality for complexes of tori over a global field of positive characteristic
items.source_version: Journal de l'Ecole polytechnique - Mathematiques 7 (2020), 831-870; publisher version accepted 2020-04-29
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a perfect pairing between the profinite group H^{2-i}_c(U,C) and the discrete torsion group H^i(U, dual of C) with values in H^3_c(U,G_m) = Q/Z, for a bounded complex C of finite flat commutative group schemes over an open subset U of a smooth projective curve over a finite field (source lines 1266-1272). The length-zero case is the cited Artin-Mazur-Milne theorem, so the substance is the induction step: the pairing has to be constructed first from Godement resolutions of bounded complexes (source lines 1235-1258), then the exact triangle A[-r] -> C -> Cone(A[-r] -> C) -> A[1-r] with A = ker(f_r) has to be dualised through the cone-and-dual isomorphism (source lines 1283-1289), and all vertical maps of the resulting diagram except the middle one must be recognised as isomorphisms by transporting the induction hypothesis across the quasi-isomorphism Cone(A[-r] -> C) -> [C_{r+1}/Im(f_r) -> ... -> C_s] and its dual (source lines 1306-1308). Applying the single-group duality theorem directly to a complex, without this devissage and the five lemma, does not give the statement.
